The annual session was attended by fourteen of the sixteen core members. Elena and Yara could not participate because of external meetings. Training covered data minimization, access control, international transfers, record retention, and incident reporting.

Twelve attendees passed the questionnaire. Pablo must repeat the section on legal bases, and Mateo must review the question concerning publication of images. Attendance alone will not count as completion; training is complete only after the questionnaire has been passed.

Héctor will organize a make-up session on 5 June for Elena, Yara, Pablo, and Mateo. Rosa will update the training register after that session. People working with VERDANT energy data will also receive a specific explanation of aggregation and inference risk.
